name: Self Esteem
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-esteem is not founded on human strength or pride but on recognizing our value as God’s intentional creation, as seen in Psalms 139:13 where God is acknowledged as the one who formed us in the womb. The Proverbs passages warn against pride, identifying it as an abomination to the Lord and a precursor to shame and destruction, while highlighting that humility precedes honor. Genuine self-esteem in Christ is rooted in fearing the Lord and hating evil, which includes rejecting arrogance and pride, thereby embracing wisdom and humility rather than self-exaltation.
